description: Shared frontend/backend fixtures of the community catalogue (epic 3, #421): facets, shelves, browse and search, the decks of an author, and the owner's editorial shelf. The public routes are GET/HEAD only with an OPTIONAL bearer, like public-read-v1 (no token is a guest; a present but invalid Bearer token is 401). They read the catalogue projection public_deck (Community/1) and the current rank generation (Community/3); only the author list also reads the publication and grant rows for the INVITE decks a signed-in viewer was granted. `invariants` are executable: the backend integration tests and the frontend contract spec compare real answers and parsers with these examples.

constants.killSwitch: learning.community.catalog.enabled (default false: every public route of this contract and /api/public/sitemap.xml answer 404 as if absent; the owner's editorial routes keep working)
constants.audienceRounding: floor to two significant digits (1234 -> 1200, 99 -> 99); below audienceMinShown the field is null, so an exact small audience never leaves the server
constants.catalogThreshold: listed = at least 10 materials, at least one exercise and a non-blank description of the published revision; a deck below it has no place in facets, shelves, browse or search, but appears in its author's decks

mechanics.listening: an exercise with audio in it

sorts.learning: «Учат сейчас» of the current generation, then rank
sorts.new: first time the deck entered the catalogue, newest first
sorts.updated: last publication of new content, newest first

constants.rankGenerationRetention: PT24H: a cursor of an older generation is 412 VERSION_CONFLICT and the client restarts the list
constants.rateLimit: the public read admission of public-read-v1 (per guest network, per IPv6 /48, per account; the shared bulkhead): 429 RATE_LIMITED and 503 PUBLIC_READ_BUSY as there

invariants: a card never carries a deck id, a revision id, a score, a rank or an exact audience below audienceMinShown
addedCount and learningNowCount are null below audienceMinShown and otherwise floored to two significant digits; the author's own account is never counted, only direct copies count
only PUBLIC decks with a published revision that are not hidden by moderation and not deleted appear anywhere in this contract except author.decks entries with access GRANTEE
facets, shelves, browse and search contain listed decks only; author.decks also contains public decks below the threshold (listed=false is not exposed, they simply appear)
a LINK deck never appears; an INVITE deck appears only in author.decks and only for a signed-in viewer with a grant, with access GRANTEE and without counts, media or mechanics
every answer is Cache-Control: no-store with Vary: Authorization, except sitemap (public, max-age=3600)
q is trimmed; an empty q is browse; longer than queryMaxLength code points is 400; with q the order is relevance and sort must be absent
topic may be a leaf or a top-level topic (a top-level topic includes its children); unknown topic, learn, level, size, media, mechanics or sort values are 400
media and mechanics are comma-separated lists; a deck must have ALL listed values; fresh=true keeps decks whose updatedAt is within freshDays

limit outside 1..pageMax, repeated parameters and malformed cursors are 400; a cursor is bound to the query and filters (another query with an old cursor is 400) and to the rank generation (an expired generation is 412)

pages never repeat a deck within one list; popular, learning and search pages also never lose one within a generation; new, updated and the author list are keyset pages on a time that a republication can move, so a deck republished while the list is read may be skipped or appear again at its new place (accepted); nextCursor is null on the last page; search returns at most searchCandidates decks in total
total counts the matching decks up to 1000 (browse) or up to searchCandidates (search); totalCapped is true when the real number may be larger
shelves contain only shelves with at least shelfMinDecks decks, each at most shelfMaxDecks; an empty catalogue answers listedCount 0 and shelves []
slug is always present (every deck here is PUBLIC) and the deck page is /d/{code}/{slug}

card.title: Испанский язык: базовые глаголы
card.description: Сорок глаголов на каждый день: настоящее время, примеры и упражнения на слух.

facets.rules: counts of listed decks; a top-level topic counts its own decks and its children's; languages are the targetLanguage values (what is learned); entries with count 0 are absent; ordered by count descending, then id; cached per instance for at most 5 minutes

shelves.rules: order editorial, learning, new, then topic shelves (leaf topics with the most listed decks, at most topicShelvesMax, popular order inside); editorial is the owner's order; learning holds decks with at least one learner in 30 days by «Учат сейчас» then rank; a deck may appear on several shelves; «<card>» stands for an object of the shape of `card`; the shelf titles are the client's («Выбор Мнемы», «Учат сейчас», «Новое», the topic name); `more` is the browse query behind «Все»

searchRules: candidates: listed decks matching the filters whose search vectors match the query (russian with stemming, simple_unaccent without), whose normalized title is similar to the normalized query (pg_trgm word similarity), or whose topic is named by the query through topic aliases («испанский», «spanish» and «español» name the topic spanish; its names and aliases also extend the text query)

relevance = 0.6 * text rank + 0.2 * title word similarity + 0.2 * popularity percentile of the current generation (0 for a deck the generation does not know yet), multiplied by 0.85 when the deck's content language is set and differs from the query's detected language (Russian when unsure)
the best searchCandidates by relevance, then deck id, are paged; ja/zh/ko text has no word segmentation in v1: their titles are found by trigram similarity only
decks.fixtures: the backend test publishes decks titled «Испанские глаголы» (topic spanish), «Spanish verbs for travel» (topic spanish, contentLanguage en), «Español para principiantes» (topic spanish, contentLanguage es), «Английские фразовые глаголы» (topic english), «日本語のひらがな» (topic japanese, contentLanguage ja), «SQL для собеседований» (topic sql-data); the queries «испанский», «Spanish», «espanol», «Español» must find the three Spanish decks and nothing else, «испнские глаголы» (a typo) must find «Испанские глаголы» first, «ひらがな» must find the Japanese deck, «sql» must find the SQL deck

author.rules: PUBLIC decks of the author (listed or not) newest update first, then, for a signed-in viewer with a grant, INVITE decks of the author with access GRANTEE (their link is /d/{code}, no slug); learningNowTotal is the sum of «Учат сейчас» over the author's public decks, null below audienceMinShown, rounded like the cards; Learning does not know the author's consent: the page asks Identity for the card first and shows «Профиль не найден» on its 404, so a profile without consent is never rendered even though this route answers

sitemap.rules: XML sitemap (sitemaps.org 0.9) of https://mnema.app/community and https://mnema.app/d/{code}/{slug} for every listed deck with lastmod = updatedAt; at most 50 000 URLs (beyond that a sitemap index is the documented next step); Cache-Control public, max-age=3600; served to crawlers as /sitemap.xml by the web server

put.rules: the owner console only (the admin chain and its owner account check); the body is the whole ordered list (at most editorialMax public codes, no duplicates); a code that is not a PUBLIC published deck is 400 with the offending codes; idempotent by commandId; If-Match is the rowVersion (412 on a stale one); every effective change writes one admin_audit row; an entry whose deck later stops being listed stays in the list with listed=false and is skipped by the shelf
